scenes.text: The signal arrived in a clean, patient rhythm.
Four pulses. A pause. Four pulses. A pause.
Astronomers spent a year deciding it was a pulsar.
Then the pause changed. It spelled a number.
The number was our own distance from Earth.
Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
